title: Selective Amortization of Full-Budget Counterfactual Reasoning for Visual Token Communication
abstract: arXiv:2609.30756v1 Announce Type: new  Abstract: Generative image communication transmits compact semantic tokens under a limited packet budget, where token selection directly affects the final reconstruction quality after the complete packet is decoded. However, accurately estimating the terminal value of every candidate token requires repeated receiver-side reconstruction, resulting in substantial encoder-side computation. To address this problem, we propose ACV-Gate, an adaptive candidate evaluation framework that learns to approximate full-budget counterfactual evaluation and selectively assigns exact evaluations to the most informative candidates. Specifically, a set-aware student is trained using terminal advantages and regrets to predict candidate rankings directly, while a selective refinement mechanism evaluates only a bounded candidate set containing both Local-MDL and direct actions; cost-based thresholds further enable explicit control of the average evaluation workload. translated_title: 面向视觉令牌通信的全预算反事实推理选择性摊销方法
translated_abstract: 生成式图像通信在有限的数据包预算下传输紧凑的语义令牌，其中令牌的选择直接影响完整数据包解码后的最终重建质量。然而，准确估计每个候选令牌的终端价值需要反复进行接收端重建，导致编码端计算量巨大。为解决这一问题，我们提出了ACV-Gate，这是一种自适应候选评估框架，它学习近似全预算反事实评估，并选择性地将精确评估分配给信息量最大的候选者。具体而言，利用终端优势和遗憾值训练一个集合感知的学生模型，以直接预测候选排名；同时，选择性细化机制仅对包含Local-MDL和直接动作的有界候选集进行评估；基于成本的阈值进一步实现了对平均评估工作量的显式控制。
tldr: 本文提出ACV-Gate自适应候选评估框架，通过学习近似全预算反事实评估，仅对最有信息量的候选令牌进行精确评估，在保证重建质量的同时大幅降低生成式图像通信中令牌选择的编码端计算开销。
en_tdlr: This paper proposes ACV-Gate, an adaptive candidate evaluation framework that learns to approximate full-budget counterfactual evaluation and selectively assigns exact evaluations only to the most informative candidate tokens, significantly reducing encoder-side computation in token selection for generative image communication while preserving reconstruction quality.
